title: Flatness criterion for a cokernel
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $T$ a scheme, with small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and constant ring sheaf $\Lambda_T$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. Let $\mathcal K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] of $\Lambda_T$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and let $a\in\mathbf Z$. Assume that $H^n(\mathcal K^\bullet\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal M)=0$ for every $\Lambda_T$-module sheaf $\mathcal M$ placed in degree $0$ and every $n<a$, where tensor denotes the ordinary total tensor complex [def-kun-derived-tensor] and $H^n$ is its cohomology sheaf [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules]. Then $\mathcal N=\operatorname{coker}(\mathcal K^{a-1}\to\mathcal K^a)$, taken in the abelian category of module sheaves, is a flat $\Lambda_T$-module sheaf.

proof.text: For every test sheaf M use the hypothesis in degree a-1<a. Vanishing of homology is equivalent to ExactAt by HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology. The proved CochainComplex.mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso identifies total tensor with M[0] with termwise tensorRight M, without a sign or change of the complex.

source.place: ## Proof, first paragraph: vanishing of H^{a-1} and exactness

proof.text: Work directly on T.smallEtaleTopology with independent object, morphism and coefficient universes. The tensor-colimit theorem supplies finite-colimit preservation of tensorLeft and, by symmetry, tensorRight; its additive corollary supplies MonoidalPreadditive. Its siteSheafTensorRightIso transports IsFlatOnSite of each term to exactness of tensorRight; symmetry gives categorical flatness. Only terms a-1 and a are needed by the following chase.

source.place: Cokernel/Tor argument; independent-universe tensor implementation supplied by TensorColimitsIndependentCoefficients

proof.text: Put d=P.d(a-1,a), d′=P.d(a-2,a-1), p=P.pOpcycles(a). For a short exact sequence S₁→S₂→S₃, tensor-colimit preservation makes d⊗Sᵢ followed by p⊗Sᵢ exact, with p⊗Sᵢ epic. To prove opcycles⊗S₁→opcycles⊗S₂ monic, take a morphism x into its kernel. After an epimorphic refinement lift x to y in Pᵃ⊗S₁, and after another refinement lift its image to z in P^(a-1)⊗S₂. The image of z in P^(a-1)⊗S₃ is a cycle; step 1 gives a boundary w in P^(a-2)⊗S₃ after a third refinement. Tensor preserves the epimorphism S₂→S₃, so lift w to w′ after a fourth refinement. Subtract d′w′ from z. The corrected z dies in P^(a-1)⊗S₃; flatness of P^(a-1) lifts it from v in P^(a-1)⊗S₁. Flatness of Pᵃ cancels the monomorphism into Pᵃ⊗S₂ and proves dv equals the refined y, since dd′=0. Thus the refined x is pdv=0. Cancelling the composite refinement, which is epic, gives x=0. This is the private fully proved flat_opcycles_of_tensor_exactAt helper, adapted from the already proved FlatModel.flat_opcycles_of_exactAt and RingedToposAcyclicKFlatPullback chase; it requires colimit preservation instead of monoidal closedness.

source.place: Cokernel-flatness Tor argument, implemented by the epimorphic-refinement diagram chase from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.FlatModel

proof.text: Right exactness and preservation of monomorphisms show exactness of tensor with P.opcycles(a); the exactness/monomorphism criterion in an abelian category supplies finite-limit preservation. Symmetry gives the right tensor functor, and siteSheafTensorRightIso transports its exactness back to IsFlatOnSite. The opcycles object is the original cokernel; no definition or statement changes.
